World.title: Colombia Town Bombing Kills Police Officer
World.content:
Key Facts Blast. A bomb went off in the nightlife district of Algeciras, Huila, killing one police officer and injuring seven.

Cause. Reports say a motorcycle loaded with explosives was used; officials have not confirmed this.

Status. No arrests, no claim of responsibility and no official attribution have been reported so far.

As of 1 November 2026, 13:00 GMT

A bomb blast in a nightlife district in Algeciras, in Colombia’s Huila department, killed a police officer and injured seven people.

A bomb blast outside a nightlife venue in Algeciras, a town in Huila department in southern Colombia, killed one police officer on the night of Saturday 31 October 2026. Seven other people were injured, according to reports on Sunday morning.

The attack matters to US readers because it hit a nightlife district, the kind of place visitors go, in a country where security conditions shape travel decisions. It also feeds into the security picture that frames US-Colombia cooperation.

Latin America Power Index · October 2026 edition Colombia ranks 6th of 14 with 51.9 points. Strongest pillar: military means (91); weakest: diplomatic & cultural influence (28). Alignment group: Closer to Washington. WatchRating below investment grade (BB-); 26 homicides per 100,000; organised crime at 7.8 of 10. See the full index, the business lens and the data →

Six of the injured were civilians and one was a police officer. The blast hit while the area was busy with people out for the evening.

What We Know

The explosion happened in the zona rosa of Algeciras, the local term for a nightlife and entertainment district. It was near a commercial venue called Las Palmitas, close to the town entrance.

Huila is a department, Colombia’s equivalent of a province, in the south of the country. Algeciras is one of its towns.

National Police officers were carrying out surveillance and control in the area when the device went off. Reports on Sunday morning said a motorcycle loaded with explosives had been used in the attack.

The use of a motorcycle has not been officially confirmed. It remains under investigation.

One police officer died and seven people were injured. Six of the injured were civilians and one was a police officer.

The injured were taken to the Municipal Hospital of Algeciras. Early reports said transfers to hospitals in Neiva, the departmental capital, were being considered.

Algeciras has seen repeated explosive attacks this year. On 12 August 2026, an explosive ambush on soldiers in a rural area of the town killed two soldiers and wounded at least 16.

Authorities preliminarily blamed the Iván Díaz Front for that August ambush. The Front is a dissident group that broke away from the FARC, the former guerrilla army, and nothing reported so far links Saturday’s attack to it.

Separately, at about 6 a.m. on Saturday 31 October, a motorcycle bomb destroyed the El Mango toll booth on the Pan-American Highway, the main north-south road, in La Sierra in Cauca, south-west Colombia. Colombian authorities attributed it to the Carlos Patiño structure, a FARC-dissident unit, and no injuries were reported.

What Is Not Known

No official statement had named the dead officer or given a final toll at the time of the first reports. The Huila Police, the Huila governor’s office and the Algeciras mayor’s office were expected to report on the officer’s identity, the injured and new security measures.

No one has been arrested, and no group has claimed responsibility. Authorities have made no official attribution.

Investigators have not said who was targeted. They have also not confirmed how the explosives were delivered.

It is also unclear whether any of the injured needed transfer to larger hospitals. Their condition has not been described in detail in the reports available.

File photo: Colombian security forces at a ceremony. It does not show the Algeciras attack or its victims.

What It Means for Travelers and US Readers

Anyone planning a trip to Colombia should check official government travel advisories before they go, including the advice issued by their own country. This report does not rely on any advisory, so the current wording for each region should be read directly.

The attack took place in a town in Huila, and reports so far describe a local incident. Nothing in the confirmed facts says that foreign visitors were targeted or hurt.

Visitors in smaller towns may wish to follow guidance from local police and municipal authorities, especially around nightlife areas. Updates are expected from the Huila Police and local officials.

For US readers, the attack adds to a pattern of explosive incidents in Huila this year, with a separate attack in Cauca the same day. Colombian authorities will show whether the incidents are connected, and so far none has said they are.

Government travel advisories can change quickly. Checking them close to departure is the safest habit.

The coming days should bring official statements on the toll, the officer and the investigation. Those statements will show how the inquiry is developing.

Frequently Asked Questions

What happened in Algeciras?

A bomb blast in the nightlife district on the night of 31 October 2026 killed one police officer and injured seven people. Six of the injured were civilians and one was a police officer.

Where is Algeciras?

Algeciras is a town in Huila department, in southern Colombia. The blast was near a venue called Las Palmitas, close to the town entrance.

Who is responsible for the attack?

No one has been arrested and no group has claimed responsibility. Authorities have made no official attribution.

Is it safe to travel to Colombia?

Conditions vary by region, so travellers should check official advisories before any trip. No confirmed report says foreign visitors were hurt in this attack.

For earlier security reporting, see our coverage of the Cúcuta explosion that wounded police and civilians and of Colombia’s order to militarise Cúcuta. More is on our Colombia news page.

Sources: Colombian Army attribution for the Cauca attack; Colombian local and national news reports of 1 November 2026. Huila and Algeciras authorities had issued no detailed statement at the time of writing.

Ticketpro lists four ticket types, all for guests aged 18 and over. They are General Admission R550 (US$33), Golden Circle R800 (US$48), VIP R950 (US$57) and VVIP with meet and greet R1,350 (US$81).

The dollar figures use 16.67 rand per US dollar, the rate on 31 October 2026. Your card bank sets the real rate, so the final charge can differ by a few cents.

Ticketpro’s page says what each tier includes only for the VVIP ticket, which carries a meet and greet. It does not say whether tickets are seated or standing, so ask before you pay for a premium tier.

Buy Bucie concert tickets in Durban only through Ticketpro, the official seller named on the page. A ticket from a stranger on social media carries a real risk of being fake.

The page does not list booking fees or a refund policy. Read the checkout page before you confirm the order.

Bucie Concert in Durban: Schedule in US Eastern Time

Ticketpro gives Wednesday 16 December 2026 for the Bucie concert in Durban. Doors open at 5 p.m., the show starts at 7 p.m. and it ends at 11:30 p.m.

South Africa has no daylight saving time, and in December the US East Coast is seven hours behind Durban. Doors open at 10 a.m. in New York, the show starts at noon and it ends at 4:30 p.m.

For readers in Chicago, subtract one more hour, and for Los Angeles subtract three more. The page gives no set times for an opening act, if there is one.

No live stream is announced for the Bucie concert in Durban. It is an in-person show, so a US fan has to be in the room.

Getting to the Bucie Concert in Durban

Ticketpro lists the venue as the Olive Convention Centre at 81 Somtseu Road, North Beach, Durban. The centre describes itself as a landmark Durban venue for conferences, concerts and private events.

Its website lists a main auditorium of 1,950 and 250 parking bays, and promises secure parking and wheelchair-friendly access. Ticketpro does not say which hall in the centre hosts the show, so the real capacity is not known.

Ticketpro says secure parking is available and that limited seats and parking are set aside for disabled guests. The centre’s phone line is +27 31 337 1110 for questions about access.

North Beach is the beachfront district in central Durban, close to the Indian Ocean promenade. The centre says it has quick access to transport routes, hotels and city attractions.

For the Bucie concert in Durban, the simplest plan is a beachfront hotel and a booked driver for the return. We found no public transport advice from the venue for late-night exits.

Safety at the Bucie Concert in Durban

Before the Bucie concert in Durban, note that the US State Department rates South Africa Level 2, exercise increased caution. Its advisory of 27 May 2025 says violent crime is common, and more common in downtown areas after dark.

The same advisory warns of smash-and-grab attacks on vehicles. Keep your phone and bag out of sight, and keep car doors locked while you drive or wait.

The advisory tells travellers to avoid driving outside metropolitan areas at night. For a concert that ends after 11 p.m., arrange the ride back before the show starts.

In an emergency, dial 10111 for the South African Police Service. The US Consulate General in Durban lists +27 31 305 7600 for office hours and +27 79 111 1445 after hours.

The State Department also warns that US health insurance and Medicare do not pay abroad. It advises travel medical cover, because private hospitals can ask for payment before treatment.

Entry Rules for US Travelers

The passport needs enough blank pages for South Africa. The State Department says travellers need two consecutive completely blank visa pages on every arrival.

South Africa also started an optional travel authorisation, which we explain in our guide: South Africa travel authorisation for Americans. Read it before you book flights.

Wednesday 16 December is the Day of Reconciliation, a public holiday in South Africa, so many offices close. Our December 2026 holidays and closures guide lists the other dates.

What Is Not Confirmed Yet

For the Bucie concert in Durban, the setlist, the opening act and the seating plan are not published. The hall inside the centre, the capacity and any door price are also unknown.

Ticketpro lists no refund rule, no ticket limit and no fees on the event page. We found no organiser website or social post, so the details rest on the Ticketpro listing and the venue’s own site.

The page does not say whether the show will be filmed or streamed. Ask the centre or Ticketpro before you buy a ticket for the Bucie concert in Durban.

More Durban Events and What Comes Next

Durban’s calendar around the show includes our guide to Sharks vs Stormers in Durban on 5 December. Golf fans can read our guide to the Alfred Dunhill Championship in Durban.

For the city itself, see our Durban expat city page. For New Year, read the Greyville Afrotainment Festival guide.

When is the Bucie concert in Durban?

Faithful With Bucie is on Wednesday 16 December 2026 at the Olive Convention Centre in Durban. The show runs from 7 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. local time, which is noon to 4:30 p.m. in New York.

Ticketpro lists four tiers, from General Admission at R550 (US$33) to VVIP at R1,350 (US$81). Golden Circle is R800 (US$48) and VIP is R950 (US$57).

No, Ticketpro marks the event 18+, so guests must be adults. The page does not say what proof of age the door will ask for, so check with Ticketpro before you travel.

No live stream is announced. It is an in-person show at the Olive Convention Centre, and tickets are sold through Ticketpro.

World.content: EAST AFRICA · FOOTBALL Key Facts Opening match Saturday 19 June 2027, in Kenya, Tanzania or Uganda; the venue is not yet announced. Final Saturday 17 July 2027; the Confederation of African Football (CAF) has not named the stadium. The field 24 national teams; Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda qualify automatically as the three hosts. Tickets No sale dates, prices or sellers announced; CAF says ticket details will come later. Watch in the US No US broadcaster announced; East Africa is seven hours ahead of New York in June and July. The Africa Cup of Nations 2027 opens on Saturday 19 June 2027 and ends with the final on Saturday 17 July 2027. It is the first time the continent’s biggest football tournament is shared by three countries, Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Ask Open the full Ask Rio Times → Why the Africa Cup of Nations 2027 Matters to US Readers The Africa Cup of Nations 2027 is the main football championship for African national teams, and CAF expects it to be the 36th edition. CAF, the body that runs football in Africa, says 24 teams will play in the finals. For a US fan this is a rare chance to see African stars in one place over four weeks. Many play for clubs in Europe, and the Africa Cup of Nations 2027 falls in the northern summer, outside the club season. The three hosts are Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda, which are neighbors in East Africa. Fans may move between the three countries during the tournament, though CAF has not yet said which cities host which matches. Africa Intelligence One email, every weekday morning. The Africa Cup of Nations 2027 opening match falls on Saturday 19 June 2027, which is Juneteenth. The final on Saturday 17 July 2027 is a weekend date as well, which helps travelers who cannot take long leave. In Plain English CAF is the Confederation of African Football, the continental governing body that owns the tournament and sets the schedule. Its official name for the 2027 edition is PAMOJA, a Swahili word for “together”, which refers to the shared hosting. A qualifying group is a mini-league of four national teams, and the best teams advance to the finals. The three hosts are already in the finals, but they still play in the qualifying groups. Dates and Times in East Africa and US Eastern For the Africa Cup of Nations 2027, CAF has confirmed the opening on Saturday 19 June 2027 and the final on Saturday 17 July 2027. Other match days, kick-off times and venues have not been published. Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda all use East Africa Time, which is three hours ahead of UTC all year. In June and July New York is on daylight time, four hours behind UTC, so East Africa is seven hours ahead of US Eastern. That means a 4 p.m. kick-off in Nairobi, Dar es Salaam or Kampala is 9 a.m. Eastern, and a 7 p.m. kick-off is noon Eastern. West Coast fans would start at 6 a.m. Pacific for the earlier game and 9 a.m. for the later one. Treat these examples as a guide to the arithmetic only, because CAF has not set any kick-off time. Do not book flights around a match until CAF publishes the full schedule. How the 24 Teams Are Decided For the Africa Cup of Nations 2027, 48 teams, including the three hosts, are in 12 qualifying groups of four. Most groups send their top two teams to the finals, but a group with a host sends only its best non-host team. Matchdays 1 and 2 ran from 21 September to 6 October 2026, and matchdays 3 and 4 follow from 9 to 17 November 2026. Our guide to the resumption of the qualifiers on 11 November covers the next round. Matchdays 5 and 6 follow from 22 to 30 March 2027, and CAF expects the full line-up of 24 teams by the end of March. Until then, big names such as Nigeria, Egypt, Senegal and Morocco are not guaranteed a place. The final draw, which sets the groups for the finals, comes only after the line-up is known. CAF has not announced the date or the city of the draw. Tickets: What Is Known CAF says ticket prices, sales dates and sales channels will be released later by CAF and the local organizers. No official seller is named yet, so any site selling tickets today is not confirmed by CAF. Watch only CAF’s official site and the three national football federations for the sale announcement. Pay by card where possible, and never send money to a social media seller or a person who offers a ticket in a private message. CAF has not said how the 2027 sales will work, whether by match, by stadium or by ticket category. Do not rely on a pattern from earlier tournaments. Demand for the opening match and the final is likely to be high. A fan who wants the final should book flexible flights and a hotel with free cancellation until the tickets are in hand. Where the Matches Will Be Played CAF has not confirmed the host cities or the stadiums. The three countries are building and renovating grounds, and our report on Tanzania’s stadium progress shows one host’s work. The largest cities in the host countries are Nairobi in Kenya, Dar es Salaam in Tanzania and Kampala in Uganda. They are the likeliest bases for visitors, but no city is confirmed as a host until CAF says so. Because the three countries are joint hosts, a team may travel between countries from one match to the next. Fans who follow a single team should wait for the final draw before booking a base city. Entry Rules and Safety for US Visitors Each host sets its own entry rules, and a US citizen needs a separate visa or permit check for Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Check each country’s official immigration site before you book, because rules and fees change and CAF does not cover them. For Kenya the US State Department advises “Exercise increased caution”, and it lists the border counties with Somalia as Level 4, “Do Not Travel”. It also lists the Nairobi districts of Eastleigh and Kibera as Level 3 for crime and kidnapping. For Tanzania the State Department advisory is Level 3, “Reconsider Travel”, raised from Level 2 on 31 October 2025, and it adds an unrest warning. It says authorities may limit or ban large gatherings, and demonstrations sometimes break out around large events. Read the current State Department page for each country in the week before you travel, because advisories can change before June. Use registered taxis or hotel cars after dark, and avoid political demonstrations near stadiums. How to Watch in the United States No US broadcaster or streaming service is announced for the Africa Cup of Nations 2027, and CAF has not published a US rights list. Check CAF’s official channels and your usual sports service in spring 2027, once the schedule is out. The kick-off arithmetic above shows that most matches will be morning or midday games on the US East Coast. Whether live games will be available in the United States at all is not confirmed. What It Means for You If you plan to attend the Africa Cup of Nations 2027, wait for the draw and the ticket announcement before you book flights. The only fixed dates are 19 June and 17 July 2027, so keep those weeks free and watch for news. To follow the Africa Cup of Nations 2027 from home, note the qualifiers on 9 to 17 November 2026 and 22 to 30 March 2027. The March games decide who joins the three hosts. If you want a safari too, book lodges early. A major football tournament will raise demand for hotels in the host cities. What Is Not Known For the Africa Cup of Nations 2027, CAF has not confirmed the host cities, the stadiums, the match schedule or the kick-off times. It has also not announced ticket prices, sales dates, official sellers or the date and place of the final draw. The US broadcaster is not announced, and the 36th-edition numbering is described by CAF as expected. Twenty-one of the 24 finalists are still to be decided in the qualifiers, and we will update this guide when CAF publishes the schedule. More East Africa Sport Our guide to the Safari Rally Kenya in Naivasha on 18 March 2027 covers another big Kenyan sports date. Both events suit a trip that adds a safari. More: Kenya news in English, every day from The Rio Times. Frequently Asked Questions When is the Africa Cup of Nations 2027? The opening match is on Saturday 19 June 2027 and the final is on Saturday 17 July 2027. CAF has not published the dates in between. Which countries host the Africa Cup of Nations 2027? Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda host it jointly, the first time three countries share the tournament. The stadiums and host cities are not yet confirmed. How can I buy tickets for the Africa Cup of Nations 2027? Ticket sales have not opened, and CAF has named no seller or prices. Watch CAF’s official site and the three national federations, and avoid unofficial sellers. How can I watch the Africa Cup of Nations 2027 in the US? No US broadcaster is announced yet. East Africa is seven hours ahead of New York, so a 7 p.m. kick-off there is noon Eastern. Who Jimmy Carr Is and Why This Tour Matters

Jimmy Carr says on his own website that he has done stand-up in more than fifty countries. He was the first British comedian to sign a stand-up deal with Netflix, in 2015.

Americans can find his Netflix specials Funny Business (2016), His Dark Material (2021) and Natural Born Killer (2024). His site says he has more than 25 years in stand-up.

The promoter calls him one of the biggest-selling comedy acts in the world. It describes the show as fast-paced, edgy one-liners from a comedian whose dark humour is not for everyone.

For a US reader the draw is simple, because the two dates sit in the middle of a southern-hemisphere summer trip. The Jimmy Carr South Africa dates fit around a safari, a wine-region stay or a beach week.

Dates, Times and Where to Buy Tickets

The first Jimmy Carr South Africa show is on Saturday 13 March 2027 at the Sunbet Arena in Pretoria. Doors open at 18:00 and the show starts at 20:00 South African time.

The second show is on Sunday 14 March 2027 at the Grand Arena at GrandWest in Cape Town. Doors open at 19:00 and the show starts at 20:00.

Tickets for the Jimmy Carr South Africa shows went on general sale at 09:00 on Friday 2 October 2026. The only sellers named by the promoter are ticketmaster.co.za and bigconcerts.co.za.

A presale for Big Concerts Fan Club members ran from Wednesday 30 September to Friday 2 October. The promoter’s page lists no prices, so check both sites for seat categories.

Buy only from the two named sellers, because a ticket from anyone else is a risk you cannot check from abroad. Each city has one show listed, so book both nights early if you want to see the tour in both cities.

The Pretoria Venue at Time Square

The Pretoria stop of the Jimmy Carr South Africa tour is the Sunbet Arena. Its owner, Sun International, calls it an 8,500-seat venue with four private hospitality suites inside Time Square, which opened in April 2017.

Time Square also has a hotel with 3-star, 4-star and 5-star rooms under one roof, plus restaurants and bars. That makes it possible to sleep, eat and see the show in the same building.

The complex houses a casino, which the owner calls the largest in Tshwane, the city municipality that includes Pretoria. The owner says no one under 18 may gamble there.

The Cape Town Venue at GrandWest

The Cape Town night takes place in the Grand Arena, which can seat up to 5,000 people or hold 7,000 standing, according to Sun International. The owner also lists a capacity of 6,866.

GrandWest calls itself the largest entertainment destination in South Africa. It has a casino, the Grand Hotel, restaurants and the only indoor ice-skating rink in the Western Cape.

The resort lists +27 21 505 7777 as its phone number. The Cape Town Cycle Tour is also on Sunday 14 March, so book a hotel early.

Tips for US Visitors

The US State Department says Americans need no visa for visits of 90 days or less. It also says your passport must have two consecutive completely blank visa pages on every arrival.

South Africa runs on SAST, two hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time all year. It is seven hours ahead of New York on Saturday 13 March and six hours on Sunday 14 March, when US clocks move forward.

The 20:00 start in Pretoria is therefore 1 p.m. in New York on Saturday. The 20:00 start in Cape Town is 2 p.m. in New York on Sunday.

The State Department advises increased caution in South Africa because of crime and civil unrest. It tells visitors to avoid walking alone after dark and to take extreme care when driving at night.

Keep car doors locked and windows closed, as the State Department advises. Plan your ride home before the show ends instead of looking for one in the dark.

The State Department gives 10111 as the local equivalent of 911 in South Africa. The US Consulate General in Cape Town is at 2 Reddam Avenue, West Lake.

What It Means for You

Americans who plan a South African trip around March 2027 can use the Jimmy Carr South Africa shows as a fixed anchor. Pretoria suits a night stop on the way to a safari, while Cape Town suits a longer holiday.

The Cape Town date is also the day of the Cape Town Cycle Tour, so expect a busy city on Sunday. Read our guide to the Cape Town Cycle Tour before you book a hotel.

Visa-exempt visitors can also look at the optional online permit. Our explainer on the South Africa travel authorisation for Americans covers the fee and who should apply.

Remember that the content is adult comedy, and the promoter itself says some people find his humour dark. No age limit is published, so check before you bring children.

What Is Not Confirmed Yet

The promoter’s page publishes no ticket prices or seat categories, so check both ticket sellers for the current price list. Prices in rand will be converted to US dollars here once they are confirmed.

No age restriction, support act or show length is published for either night. Whether a third South African date will be added is not known.

Whether the shows will sell out is not known. This guide will be updated if the promoter publishes more details.

When does Jimmy Carr play in South Africa?

He plays Pretoria on Saturday 13 March 2027 and Cape Town on Sunday 14 March 2027. Both shows start at 20:00 South African time.

Where can Americans buy Jimmy Carr tickets in South Africa?

The promoter names Ticketmaster South Africa (ticketmaster.co.za) and its own site, bigconcerts.co.za. General sale opened on Friday 2 October 2026.

Do Americans need a visa to see the shows?

The US State Department says no visa is needed for visits of 90 days or less. Your passport needs two consecutive completely blank visa pages.

Love the 90s Chile takes place on Sunday 21 March 2027 at Espacio Riesco, a large events centre in northern Santiago. It is a one-day dance party built around hit acts from the 1990s, and every guest must be 18 or older.

What the Chile Festival Is and Who Plays

Love the 90s Chile is a festival that plays the dance and pop hits of the 1990s with artists who made them famous. The organiser says its format comes from big shows it stages in Spain, and its website lists a Latin American tour.

Date, Venue and How to Get There

Love the 90s Chile takes place on Sunday 21 March 2027. The ticket page lists the start as 5:30 p.m., but no closing time is published, so plan for a late ride home.

The venue is Espacio Riesco, at Avenida El Salto 5000 in Huechuraba, a district on the northern edge of Santiago. The venue calls itself the most important events and convention centre in Chile, with 27,000 square metres (about 290,000 square feet) of covered halls.

The festival site covers 160,000 square metres (about 40 acres) and offers more than 2,500 parking spaces, according to the venue. The organiser says the 2027 festival will use a different, larger zone than the 2026 show.

The venue’s location page offers route tools for car, bus and Metro, the city’s subway, but it names no station or shuttle. Use a ride-hailing app or licensed taxi and agree on a pickup point before you leave.

The venue’s phone number is +56 2 2470 4400 for questions about access. Our Santiago city page explains neighbourhoods and transport, and our Santiago November guide lists shows closer to today.

Tickets, Prices and Zones in US$

Puntoticket is the ticket seller shown on the organiser’s page for Love the 90s Chile. Every price below includes the 15 percent service charge, converted at CLP 986 per US dollar (US$1) on 31 October 2026.

In general sale, the page lists Pista General, the standing floor, at CLP 74,750 (about US$76). Front Stage, a zone closer to the stage with its own bars, food points and toilets, costs CLP 109,250 (about US$111).

Earlier presale rounds were cheaper, with Pista General at CLP 57,500 (about US$58) in the first round. The page shows those rounds as past price lists, so do not expect those prices today.

Standing VIP, a raised platform with shade, reached CLP 184,000 (about US$187) in the third presale round. A VIP Table for four, with a bottle of sparkling wine and a bottle of spirits, started at CLP 1,035,000 (about US$1,049).

The general-sale list shows no Standing VIP or table prices, so those zones may be sold out or closed. Check Puntoticket before you plan around them.

Puntoticket also shows a 20 percent Flash Weekend discount that does not apply to the service charge. The page gives no dates for it and does not say which zones it covers.

All tickets are issued in the buyer’s name. Naming and download of the e-ticket open on Monday 8 March 2027 at noon, and you need it to be sent to your zone.

Entry Rules and Accessibility

The Love the 90s Chile ticket page says the event is for guests aged 18 and over, and everyone pays for a ticket. The ticket is issued in the holder’s name, so use the name on your passport when you buy.

Professional photo and video cameras are not allowed. The page lists no other prohibited items, so ask the organiser or venue about bags before you travel.

Guests in wheelchairs must come with a companion, and each of them needs their own ticket. The page does not describe an adapted viewing platform, so ask before you buy.

The page says the show will not be stopped for rain unless the authorities order it. Pack for weather that can change during a long open-air day.

The page does not describe a refund right, a bag policy or a re-entry rule. Ask the organiser about re-entry before you leave the grounds.

Tips for US and Foreign Visitors

The State Department says US citizens on a tourist passport need no visa for a stay of up to 90 days in Chile. It also says your passport must be valid for the period of your stay.

The State Department’s Chile advisory is level 2, exercise increased caution, because of crime and civil unrest. It says large protests occur periodically in Santiago and often disrupt buses and the Metro.

Love the 90s Chile falls on a Sunday evening, so expect a rush for rides after the last act. Book your ride or hotel transfer in advance rather than hunting for a car in the crowd.

Keep your phone, passport copy and cash close in a dense crowd, as at any large festival. Use a hotel safe for your passport and carry only the ID that the ticket requires.

Our Creamfields Chile guide and our Santiago Rocks guide cover other big shows in Santiago. For a longer stay, our holidays and closures guide lists the December dates when offices shut.

What Is Not Known Yet

The set times, the running order and the closing time of Love the 90s Chile are not published. The organiser has also not said whether more acts will join the seven names on the list.

The ticket page gives no price for parking, no official shuttle and no named Metro station. It also lists no bag rules, so these details may change before 21 March.

The Flash Weekend discount, the status of the VIP zones and the number of tickets left are all unclear for Love the 90s Chile. The organiser’s own website still shows an older price list from CLP 55,000 (about US$56), so rely on Puntoticket for current prices.
